optimization.action_description: Add a repo-side verifier for the vLLM/FlashInfer TRT-LLM prepared FP4 MoE weight layout. The verifier reimplements row permutation locally and uses the in-repo NVFP4 128x4 scale swizzle helper, then compares against FlashInfer row-index helpers and FlashInfer scale interleave byte-for-byte.
optimization.implementation: GEMM1 prepared rows use gated w3/w1 interleave followed by block32 row shuffle. GEMM2 prepared rows use block32 row shuffle. For both stages, scale rows use the same row permutation before NVFP4 block_scale_interleave. This mirrors prepare_static_weights_for_trtllm_fp4_moe without calling it as the candidate path.
optimization.expected_impact: This fixes the prepared-layout ambiguity before connecting an own FP4 BMM/grouped GEMM. A custom GEMM consuming the user-required prepared tensors must read rows through this permutation or account for the permuted output row order.

correctness.reference: probe_prepared_weight_layout.py compares local row indices to FlashInfer helpers and compares locally prepared random uint8/fp8 weight tensors against FlashInfer swizzle output.

performance.note: Prepared weights are static/offline, so these timings are not part of the runtime MoE target. They record the repo-local layout transform cost only.

quality_gate.reason: The prepared weight layout contract is now byte-verified for full TP=1 G11 tensor sizes, but end-to-end candidate GEMM still needs to be replaced with an own tensor-core FP4 implementation that beats flashinfer.trtllm_fp4_block_scale_moe.

next_step.description: Connect the packed hidden BMM activation layout to a custom FP4 GEMM that consumes the prepared row-permuted weights/scales directly, or explicitly compensates for the prepared output row order before SwiGLU/finalize.
